"Readers can click the link to view the printable version of the puzzle.

addition the standard Sudoku rules are in effect, with a twist: the digits inside each grey‑lined region must sum to the number shown in that region’s corner.

Within each grey‑lined shape, no digit may appear more than once.

To see the solution, purchase the upcoming Observer Digital Edition.

Enjoy solving the challenge and check your answers when the edition is released."
